purpose: Define reusable cross-specialist collaboration patterns without transferring canonical effect ownership between repositories.

patterns.goal: Research, design, build, validate and ship a high-quality website or product experience.

sequence.role: live context, capability discovery and evidence synthesis
requirements, systems and delivery framing when needed
journeys, IA, usability, accessibility and interaction requirements
UI system, states, responsive design and handoff
brand identity and visual-system constraints when applicable
bespoke raster/illustration asset production
preservation-first cleanup/restoration of supplied raster assets
source implementation, repair and governed publication
SEO/search/site-quality evidence and remediation guidance
consent-aware product/site instrumentation and behavioural measurement
browser/responsive/accessibility/performance QA
final cross-domain release-quality assurance

patterns.goal: Create, refine, master and release professional creative assets without collapsing specialist craft boundaries.

sequence.role: brief/context synthesis and specialist selection
creative territories, concepts and anti-generic pressure testing
identity/brand-system authority when brand constraints apply
raster/illustration creation and art-direction execution
vector conversion, SVG/Lottie and editable vector delivery
restoration, cleanup, upscale and preservation-first mastering
final technical/visual release QA

patterns.goal: Produce effects that behave dynamically but visually belong in cel animation.

sequence.role: deterministic effect behaviour, timing source, simulation and flipbook candidates
drawn/cel pose, timing, visual-standard, inbetween and sequence authority
long-form environmental audiovisual composition when required
editorial/compositor/mastering when the final target is video
final parity/quality validation

patterns.goal: Design, author, implement, test and deliver a game while preserving reusable engine/runtime ownership.

sequence.role: current project/capability context
systems, content, levels, balance and playtest design
terrain, water, sky, atmosphere and environment gameplay semantics
cartography/terrain/map rendering and geographic/fantasy map systems when applicable
game art asset production
sprite cleanup, animation QA, atlas and runtime packaging
materials/textures/wear/damage/wetness systems
music, voice, SFX and game-audio mastering
reusable Godot engine systems
boot, saves, progression, platform, accessibility and runtime shell
multiplayer/community/online services when needed
source integration and governed publication
Godot/game runtime validation
final cross-domain release QA

patterns.goal: Research, write, compose and deliver professional evidence-backed documents and publications.

sequence.role: source corpus, OCR/HTR, evidence, Office/PDF/CAD/BIM analysis
evidence synthesis and current contextual reasoning
drafting/editing and voice/copy authority
editable document/workspace composition
presentation/executive collateral/motion publication composition
brand constraints and identity assets
release and cross-domain quality assurance

patterns.knownBoundary: Professional tagged PDF/PDF-UA and full press/prepress output remain separate maturity concerns and must not be claimed from ordinary PDF export.

patterns.goal: Turn business questions into evidence-backed recommendations and bounded implementation work.

sequence.role: context, evidence and capability discovery
Australian commercial, contract, privacy, tax, procurement and negotiation intelligence
technology discovery, requirements, options, roadmap and transformation planning
cost, estimate, uncertainty and bid/variation analysis when required
quantitative modelling, finance, statistics and optimization
marketing strategy/growth/measurement when required
reviewed relationship/outreach/inbox lifecycle when required
client/project/commercial operational records and workflow
technical implementation when recommendation becomes source work

patterns.goal: Work with structured data without falsely assigning enterprise BI authority to a single existing specialist.

sequence.role: deterministic structured-data conversion/canonicalization, Parquet/DuckDB/SQLite mechanics
site/product analytics and instrumentation quality
quantitative/statistical/optimization analysis
data governance, architecture and transformation framing
cross-source synthesis and coverage-gap reasoning

patterns.knownBoundary: No current participant should claim end-to-end enterprise warehouse/semantic-layer/BI authority unless a current canonical contract explicitly adds it.

patterns.goal: Discover, understand and safely control physical/network devices through the correct authority chain.

sequence.role: LAN/network visibility, discovery and reachability
hardware/device truth, profiles, safety, operation catalog and physical acceptance
typed device asset, enrollment, connector, capability grant and command brokerage after source restoration/acceptance
bounded commissioned hardware/HID/radio gateway operations
GUI interaction fallback where device control requires visible UI
KVM/power/media recovery only

blockedUntil.universal-manipulator: source restored, reviewed, configured, transport-online and physically accepted
